svg.title: s3mirror
svg.desc: Bucket mirroring. Mirrors every bucket between S3-compatible endpoints, copying only new or changed objects, in parallel. Built in: Python, with boto3. Ships as: Homebrew tap and a GHCR image. Install: brew tap netspeedy/s3mirror, then brew install s3mirror.
svg.text: Mirrors every bucket between S3-compatible endpoints, copying
only new or changed objects, in parallel.
Homebrew tap and a GHCR image
